difficulty_reason: The affine case is complete in the span: equal vanishing sets give mutual containments I^c subset J, J^d subset I (Noetherian power lemma); the I-adic and J-adic completions of A then agree (algebra-lemma-change-ideal-completion); applying lemma-inverse-systems-affine (card L16388) twice transfers the equivalence. The general case glues explicitly: quasi-compactness produces global exponents c, d with I^c subset J and J^d subset I, and the functor is written down - (F_n) maps to the system (F_{cn}/J^n F_{cn}), which lands in Coh(X, J) with the verification checked on an affine covering (the author's single omitted-details clause), symmetrically in the other direction, with the mutual-inverse check named-omitted.

dedup.scope: Invariance of the formal coherent category under passing to ideals of the same support (definition of the formal scheme depends only on the support).
